dimensions.note: No credentials or tokens. The config holds repo slugs, display names, local workdir paths, agent/model choices, and branch names — none sensitive.

discoverConfig logs the loaded pair count and addRepoPair logs the derived id, using structured placeholders. The other mutators delegate their completion log to discoverConfig; no interpolation and no sensitive data.

readConfigFile distinguishes an absent file (empty config) from a present-but-malformed one (parse/validation errors propagate), so a corrupt config is not silently overwritten. Write errors propagate.

pr_sweep_config_test.ts covers deriveId (case, separators, leading/trailing dashes) and renderConfigSummary (empty state and a table row per pair, including the new model column). File I/O methods are not unit-tested; the TUI/workflow is the integration path.

addRepoPair derives a stable id from the name but does not check for an existing id, so adding a pair with a name already present creates a duplicate entry. removeRepoPair filters all entries with that id, so a duplicate is recoverable. Non-blocking; pre-existing behaviour.
No external HTTP or network calls; a local JSON file is the only interface.
Reads/writes one JSON file with Deno.readFile/writeFile; no handles, connections, or temp files to leak.
README uses example repos (Kilo-Org/kilocode, maphew/kilocode) and generic workdirs; test fixtures use /work paths. No secrets or internal infrastructure identifiers.
All schemas are plain z.object(...) with no .passthrough(); the new model field is declared on RepoPairSchema with a default, so CEL validation works.
The config resource and summary file set lifetime 365d and garbageCollection 10, appropriate for durable operator configuration.
Full configuration surface: discover (read), addRepoPair, removeRepoPair (delete), toggleRepoPair, updateRepoPair.
No external mutation; the model only writes its local config file and data resources.
config-current and summary-current are unique and written by every method via discoverConfig.
The source of truth is the local JSON file; the model reads no stored swamp resources.
Bumped to 2026.10.23.1 with an upgrades entry for the optional per-pair model surfaced by addRepoPair/updateRepoPair and the summary table, on top of the 2026.10.14.1 entry.

mechanical.schema-write-conformance: pass — config-current is written from the validated ConfigSchema and summary-current from renderConfigSummary; every RepoPair field, including the new model, is populated. No placeholder writes.
mechanical.truncation-honesty: pass — no pagination or result capping; all pairs are written and rendered.
mechanical.instance-name-consistency: pass — every method funnels through discoverConfig, so config-current and summary-current always share one shape.
mechanical.schema-field-coverage: pass — all Config/RepoPair fields have a producing path, including the new model default and the existing enabled/agent/mainBranch/swampRepoDir defaults.
